# P31.17 — LLM annotation first pass for camera-site resolution (P31)

- **Semantic id:** `ANNOTATE.1` · **Phase:** 31 · **Kind:** ticket · **Tag:** p31-followups · **Wave:** B tail
- **base_branch:** `devin/p31-16-rematerialize-reexport-republish` (set finally at Wave-B seed) · **Depends on:** P31.10 (the stratified campaign sampler `sig-resolution review sample`), P30.2b (the camera-site run, `camera_site_gold.json` camera-2)
- **Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/P31.17__llm-annotation-first-pass.md live_verification=true`
- **Gate status:** engineering. **RATIFIED 2026-09-24 (operator, LEDGER § GATE DECISIONS "Round 9 ratification",
  Q11) — CHANGED from the proposal:** human review is **deferred**; this ticket is an **LLM annotation first pass
  using `claude-opus-5-5`** over a stratified sample (~400 camera-site pairs). It is **NOT human ground truth**:
  it does **not** close D-R6.1-EVAL, and the public PROVISIONAL disclosure stays. The human review campaign and
  P31.18 (the eval re-derivation from human labels) move to **Round 10**. The API key comes from the environment
  or Secret Manager only (HG-09); if no key is available the ticket ships the harness + fixture run and records
  the hosted pass as RETURN PASS.

## Goal
Get a larger, stratified, clearly-labelled **LLM** read on the camera-site proposals now, and measure how well it
agrees with the labels we already have, so Round 10's human campaign can be sized and targeted (which tiers and
strata disagree most) instead of guessed.

## Load (cite; do not copy)
- `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` rows **D-R6.1-EVAL**, **D-P30.2b-1**, **D-P30.2b-2**. ADR-099 (eval loop), **ADR-105**
  (camera-site ER: LLM labels are a sensitivity figure, never a gate; κ 0.669 < 0.70 → the LLM is a suggester only;
  revisit trigger (c)).
- Data: `resolution/src/resolution/data/camera_site_gold.json` (`camera-2`, 540 pairs; verifier label
  `agent:claude-opus-5-5@sig-maintainer-seed`; earlier LLM run `llm:claude-opus-5-5@camera-rules-v1-blind`);
  `camera_site_rules.toml` v2; the hosted `review_item` queue (11,625 items) and the P31.10 sampler.
- Reports: `docs/build/reports/P28.1_resolution_eval.md`, `docs/build/runs/P30.2b.md`.

## In scope — deliverables
1. **Sample.** Draw ~400 pairs with `sig-resolution review sample` (P31.10), stratified across auto tiers 1g/3g and
   proposal tiers 4g/5g plus the soft-conflict and disputed/adjudicator-disagreement buckets; record the seed and
   strata counts. Include the existing 540 `camera-2` pairs' overlap explicitly so agreement can be computed on the
   overlap, and keep the frozen holdout's identity (it is not re-labelled into training).
2. **Annotate.** Run `claude-opus-5-5` in a fresh context per batch that sees **only** the written adjudication rules
   and each pair's evidence sheet (public camera-site fields: coordinates, operator, source, ref, name, jurisdiction,
   distance/density features) — blind to the matcher's tier and to the existing labels. No person or plate data is
   ever sent (Part VIII). Labels: `match` / `no_match` / `not_enough_information`, with a short rationale. Record the
   exact model id, prompt digest, rules version, date and per-pair raw output as a new labelled adjudicator
   (`llm:claude-opus-5-5@camera-rules-v2-firstpass`), append-only.
3. **Agreement report.** Against (a) the P30.2b seed/verifier labels and (b) the earlier LLM run: Cohen's κ, raw
   agreement, confusion matrices, per tier and per stratum, with Wilson 95% intervals; list the disagreement pairs.
   State plainly that **all three label sources are the same model family** (`claude-opus-5-5`), so agreement
   measures consistency, not correctness, and this is not the "stronger adjudicator" of ADR-105's revisit trigger (c).
4. **Record, don't act.** Write `docs/build/reports/P31.17_llm_annotation_first_pass.md` (generator script
   committed). The labels may route items to the review queue as **suggestions** (ADR-105), but they never
   auto-write, never change thresholds, and never feed clustering as decisions. Append a note to D-R6.1-EVAL (stays
   OPEN) with the result and the recommended Round-10 human sample design (size per stratum from the observed
   disagreement).

## Out of scope
- Human review, curator tokens, κ between humans (Round 10). P31.18 / any threshold or rules-v3 change (Round 10).
- Dropping or softening the PROVISIONAL disclosure on any public surface.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] ~400 stratified pairs annotated by `claude-opus-5-5`, blind, with raw outputs + prompt digest recorded append-only *(live, or fixture + RETURN PASS without a key)*.
- [ ] Agreement vs the seed/verifier labels and vs the earlier LLM run, per tier and stratum, with κ + Wilson intervals *(measured)*.
- [ ] The report says explicitly: not human ground truth; same model family; D-R6.1-EVAL stays OPEN; PROVISIONAL stays *(deterministic check on the report text)*.
- [ ] No auto-write, threshold, rules or clustering change; `make check` green.

## Cross-cutting invariants
Cited from `docs/tickets/00_MANIFEST.md` and design §5: LLM labels are labelled inference, never ground truth
(ADR-099/105, §3.1); append-only; secrets via env/Secret Manager only (HG-09); no person/plate data leaves the
system (Part VIII); never fabricate a number; no merge/tag/push-main.
